name: Joanna Newsom
label: Drag City
lede: Joanna Newsom plays a pedal harp and sings in a voice critics argued over, and in six years she goes from a twelve-song debut to an 18-song triple album.

eras.title: A five-year-old asks for a harp
eras.text: Newsom grows up in Nevada City, in California's Gold Country foothills, in a house of musicians. She moves from Celtic harps to a full pedal harp, then to Mills College and a keyboard job in a San Francisco band. Two homemade CDs reach Will Oldham.

years.h: Born in Grass Valley, raised next door in Nevada City
years.p: Her father plays guitar and her mother is a classically trained pianist.

years.h: At five, Newsom asks for a harp
years.p: Piano comes first, then small Celtic harps. The full-size pedal harp arrives in seventh grade.

years.h: A Mills College student joins The Pleased on keyboards
years.p: Newsom plays with guitarist [[Noah Georgeson|cacf76c5-f3f2-4c35-ba0c-d3f2a07c3949]] in the San Francisco band while studying composition and creative writing. She leaves Mills to make music full time.

years.h: Walnut Whales is her first homemade CD
years.p: Newsom records and releases it herself, harp and voice. Several of its songs come back in 2004 on The Milk-Eyed Mender.

years.h: Newsom plays harp for Nervous Cop
years.p: The self-titled record is a project of [[Zach Hill|df6a1106-6caf-465b-bcfd-0b80d2b53516]] of [[Hella|1ecbc7e5-6e33-4062-997d-abc550dd63e6]] and [[Greg Saunier|2ae4e9b4-9e8b-4a98-920d-4f3a881dac96]] of [[Deerhoof|11eabe0c-2638-4808-92f9-1dbd9c453429]].

years.h: Will Oldham hears Yarn and Glue, and Drag City signs her
years.p: Newsom's second homemade EP reaches [[Will Oldham|eb51090c-662a-47a1-967c-c63292d9831a]], who passes her along to the Chicago label Drag City.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says Oldham was impressed enough to invite her on tour, then gave the recording to Drag City's owner. Oldham records for the label as [[Bonnie 'Prince' Billy|7b0a63b2-b8e8-490e-b724-1d30cb5edfe3]].

Drag City still lists both homemade EPs, Walnut Whales and Yarn and Glue, in her discography as self-released CDs.

eras.title: A voice that split rooms
eras.text: The Milk-Eyed Mender never charted, and listeners either fell for the voice or couldn't stand it. It sold anyway, past 200,000 copies, and Newsom spent the next two years on the road.

years.src: Wikipedia: The Milk-Eyed Mender · Wikipedia: Joanna Newsom
years.h: The Milk-Eyed Mender sells past 200,000 copies without charting
years.p: Twelve songs of harp, harpsichord and Wurlitzer, produced by her Pleased bandmate [[Noah Georgeson|cacf76c5-f3f2-4c35-ba0c-d3f2a07c3949]]. Newsom wrote all of it except the Appalachian ballad Three Little Babes.
years.xp:
Georgeson also plays guitar and sings backup. Pitchfork later ranks the record No. 47 among the best albums of the 2000s, and NME puts it 12th on a list of the best folk albums of all time.

Critics kept reaching for "childlike" about her singing. Newsom has said she'd rather call it "untrainable."

The songs travel. [[Bombay Bicycle Club|0ae49abe-d6af-44fa-8ab0-b9ace5690e6f]] covers Swansea, and [[The Roots|80b3cf5e-18fe-4c59-98c7-e5bb87210710]] build their 2010 track Right On around The Book of Right-On.

yt: Sprout and the Bean, official video
years.h: Sprout and the Bean steps out as a CD single
years.p: Drag City issues the song that opens The Milk-Eyed Mender as a CD5, catalog DC287, with a video of its own.

years.h: Newsom and Bill Callahan become a Drag City couple
years.p: Callahan records as [[Smog|89af9575-4d72-4345-8eba-e9de3d36ac34]]. Wikipedia dates the relationship from 2004 to 2007.

eras.title: Five songs, 55 minutes
eras.text: For the follow-up Newsom goes long: five songs, an orchestra arranged by Van Dyke Parks, harp and voice taped by Steve Albini, a mix by Jim O'Rourke. According to Wikipedia, the songs deal with the sudden death of her best friend, a continuing illness and a tumultuous relationship.

years.h: Albini tapes Newsom's harp and voice at Village Recording
years.p: The December sessions in Los Angeles for Ys are all analog, on two 24-track machines.

years.h: Van Dyke Parks writes an orchestra for four of the five songs
years.p: [[Van Dyke Parks|74be7080-080f-49d0-b8c5-1166eed1bb8e]], who made Song Cycle in 1967, co-produces and arranges at Entourage Studios in Los Angeles.
years.xp: Tim Boyle records the orchestra. [[Jim O'Rourke|172aab84-4c01-4dc0-b2ad-e723033e10ec]] mixes the album and it is mastered at Abbey Road. Wikipedia lists Parks' Song Cycle and Roy Harper's 1971 Stormcock as models.

years.cap: Newsom in Oklahoma City, December 2006, a month after Ys
years.h: Ys, named for a sunken city, is her first Billboard 200 entry
years.p: The five songs are Emily, Monkey & Bear, Sawdust & Diamonds, Only Skin and Cosmia. The album enters at No. 134, and Pitchfork scores it 9.4.
years.xp:
Newsom's sister Emily sings on Emily, which opens the record at 12:07. [[Bill Callahan|c309d914-93af-4b3f-8058-d79c75ea89da]] sings backup on Only Skin, which runs 16:53.

Ys sells 9,000 copies in its first week. By March 2010, Wikipedia says, it has sold more than 250,000. It is nominated for the 2007 Shortlist Music Prize.

years.big: "Every elaboration has a purpose, every labyrinthine melodic detour feels necessary."
years.h: Uncut hears a plan inside the sprawl
years.p: John Mulvey reviews Ys for Uncut. The shortest song, Cosmia, still runs 7:15.
years.xp:
After twelve short songs on The Milk-Eyed Mender, Newsom hands Drag City five. Not every reviewer needs convincing: AllMusic's Heather Phares calls it "a demanding listen, but it's also a rewarding and inspiring one."

Metacritic's average for Ys is 85.

years.cap: Newsom at The Sage, Gateshead, January 2007
years.h: The Ys Street Band EP puts Colleen on a record
years.p: Newsom's touring band plays the new song next to reworked older material. Drag City catalog DC336.
play: Joanna Newsom and the Ys Street Band

years.h: Newsom and Callahan part ways
years.p: Wikipedia dates the end of the relationship to 2007.

eras.title: Losing the voice, filling three discs
eras.text: Midway through the next record Newsom's voice gives out. Vocal cord nodules keep her silent for two months, and the singing that comes back is lower, rounder and less sharp-edged. It goes into a triple album.

years.h: Nodules on her vocal cords silence Newsom for two months
years.p: She can't speak for two months. Work on the instrumental parts of the new album keeps going while vocal tracking stops.
years.xp: The recovery changes how she sings. Wikipedia notes the difference is audible on Have One on Me, part of which was sung before the nodules and the rest after.

years.cap: Newsom on the Have One on Me tour, May 2010
years.src: Wikipedia: Have One on Me · Drag City
yt: On a Good Day on Letterman, December 2010
years.h: Have One on Me fills three discs and peaks at No. 75
years.p: Eighteen songs, 124 minutes, recorded in 2009 at studios from Weed, California, to Berkeley to New York, then mixed in Los Angeles and Tokyo.
years.xp:
[[Ryan Francesconi|88bdf861-1561-4bfd-8bc2-99bb5499ed11]] arranges and conducts, and [[Neal Morgan|99df250f-7065-4bb5-ae31-7bd6a7ca2b83]] arranges the drums and percussion. [[Jim O'Rourke|172aab84-4c01-4dc0-b2ad-e723033e10ec]] and [[Noah Georgeson|cacf76c5-f3f2-4c35-ba0c-d3f2a07c3949]] mix it.

Pitchfork gives it 9.2. Songs include Good Intentions Paving Company, Baby Birch and '81. On December 14, 2010 she plays On a Good Day on Letterman.

years.cap: Newsom live at an Auditorium show, September 2010
years.h: The Roots turn The Book of Right-On into Right On
years.p: [[The Roots|80b3cf5e-18fe-4c59-98c7-e5bb87210710]] sample and rework the Newsom song for their 2010 album How I Got Over.

years.h: What We Have Known gets a 12-inch
years.p: Drag City presses it on vinyl, catalog DC287V.

eras.title: A wedding, a narrator, and Divers
eras.text: Newsom marries, steps into film for Paul Thomas Anderson, and spends years on a fourth album. Divers arrives with an Anderson video and becomes her first No. 1 on a Billboard chart.

years.h: Newsom marries Andy Samberg in Big Sur
years.p: The groom is the comedian from Saturday Night Live and The Lonely Island. The wedding is in Big Sur, California.

years.h: Newsom narrates Inherent Vice as Sortilège
years.p: In Paul Thomas Anderson's Thomas Pynchon adaptation she plays Sortilège and narrates. Rolling Stone's Peter Travers calls the narration "gorgeously rendered."
years.xp: It isn't her first screen work: she has already turned up in the sketch show Portlandia. Anderson directs her next music video the following year.

years.h: Paul Thomas Anderson films Sapokanikan around New York
years.p: Newsom announces Divers with the single and the video. The clip later screens on her tour.

years.cap: Newsom at the Orpheum Theatre, December 2015, on the Divers tour
years.h: Divers is her first No. 1, on Billboard's Alternative chart
years.p: It sells 14,000 units in week one, her best start. Arrangements come from [[Nico Muhly|cd9e43ec-12dc-4567-9c60-1e554164cf05]] (Anecdotes), [[David Longstreth|cf8a8d1c-fa71-4582-ab64-c63e42c8a11d]] of [[Dirty Projectors|71a94ed8-03cc-459a-bd35-a081ca88a402]] (Time, As a Symptom) and [[Ryan Francesconi|88bdf861-1561-4bfd-8bc2-99bb5499ed11]].
years.xp:
[[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]] engineers and [[Noah Georgeson|cacf76c5-f3f2-4c35-ba0c-d3f2a07c3949]] co-produces and mixes, with the City of Prague Philharmonic Orchestra on the record. It debuts at No. 2 on the vinyl chart, on 3,000 LPs. Ys had sold 9,000 in its first week.

Pitchfork calls it a love letter in the form of a reckoning with death. The New York Times' Ben Ratliff writes that "almost nothing in the way this music is composed, produced or recorded seems incidental or accidental."

Metacritic's average is 88 from 33 reviews, her highest.

eras.title: New songs nobody can buy yet
eras.text: After Divers Newsom goes quiet on record. She comes back to stages with unrecorded songs, and an old collaborator's death marks how long it has been.

years.h: Surprise opening sets for Fleet Foxes, with five new songs
years.p: Newsom debuts Bombs Are Whistling and Marie at the Mill on the March dates, opening for [[Fleet Foxes|fa97dd36-1b82-43d7-a6e4-2adeafd59cef]].

years.h: Steve Albini dies at 61
years.p: [[Steve Albini|a4d486bd-6020-4a36-9c7d-bf5ce174bcd1]] dies of a heart attack in Chicago. He recorded Newsom's harp and voice for Ys and engineered Divers.

years.cap: Newsom at the Masonic Lodge at Hollywood Forever, Los Angeles, 2024
years.h: Hollywood Forever Cemetery hosts a Newsom residency
years.p: She debuts more new songs across a short run of shows in Los Angeles.

years.h: Nevada City declares May 27 Joanna Newsom Day
years.p: The Gold Country town where she grew up gives her a day of her own.
